subject: Girl Friendly Scary Movies
author: ZombieTron
body:
Evil Dead, Dusk til Dawn, or The Final Destination series might work for you.. a lot of scary movies might not tho! Have you thought of a RomCom instead? how about combine the two with Shawn of the Dead?

Saw (the first 3), Hellraiser (most of them), Aliens (all of the Alien movies), Cube, Ring, Eye, Creep, Nightmare on Elm Street, The Hole, The Descent, Omen, Texas Chainsaw Massacre (original). Romero's Zombie movies, and many more are all good horror movies but you may not get the required result!!

Good Luck!
